abstracts.value: We introduce and investigate a simple model of conditional quantum dynamics. It allows for a discussion of the information-theoretic aspects of quantum measurements, decoherence, and environment-induced superselection (einselection).

titles.title: Einselection and Decoherence from an Information Theory Perspective
